---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

Describe the feature clearly and concisely.

## Motivation / Problem

- Why is this feature needed?
- What problem does it solve?
- Who would benefit from it?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution or implementation ideas. Include any relevant diagrams, code snippets, or links.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered other approaches? Why were they not chosen?

## Impact

- Which parts of the project will this affect?
- Are there breaking changes?

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, mockups, or any other context that could help reviewers.
